title: The Little Stones Come Home
synopsis: The loaded dump truck reaches Pine Park by the service lane, adults spread and compact the selected crushed stone at the gate, and Jack connects the season to the park’s original construction in his notebook.
continuity_state: Before: Mr. Fred has prepared a graded crushed-stone load in a green dump truck and verified its weight on the yard weighbridge. The small worn strip beside the Pine Park entrance is waiting for repair. The finished park loop, Little Bridge, farm, garage and firehouse remain usable. After: The green road dump truck delivered the graded crushed stone by the north service lane. Aunt Jo’s crew used a compact loader and a small roller to repair only the worn strip beside Pine Park entrance; the patch was checked and reopened. The rest of the park was unchanged. Jack’s blue notebook now links quarry, crusher, screen, conveyor, stockpile, wheel loader, weighbridge, road dump truck and finished path, beside his original Season One gravel drawing. Mr. Fred and his yard persist in the wider world, and Molly and Rex reunite at Pancake Hill.
